notes.ortho: Positional orthology from unique flanking sequence (>=80% identity, >=200 bp), single best hit per target assembly. "Orthologous to" lists distinct partner assemblies then the total partner-locus count.
notes.flag: 0 catalogue loci annotated by arbitration, plus the 117 uncatalogued candidates (not catalogue members). Only 0 are a seed/rescan contradiction (the rescan scored another family >=20 bits above the seed; the seed family is retained). The rest are close-margin calls (segment or seed-conflict resolved with a margin below 15 bits) or loci without a seed.
notes.full: Every locus (923, all 4 assemblies) with its sub-subfamily call and both flanks' cross-assembly orthology status (ssearch36, >=80% identity, >=200 bp, single best hit per target assembly). L/R badges show each flank's class.
